। pArAvAretivyastaM samastaM viparItaYca” si॰ kO॰ । vyastaH “vyastarAtrindivasya te” kumA॰ pfTakkaraRe evEkaSaH prayIge vyastaH “vyastasamastamahAvyAhftihome” Bavadeva । nivAraRe ca “vyasyannudanyAM SiSirEH payoBiH” BawwiH । vikzepe “vyastAstArAgaRAiva” BA॰ । vi--ni--arpaRe । “vizRorvakzasi viSvanATakftinA sidDAntamuktAvalI vinyastA” si॰ mu॰ “viBAgavinyastamahArGaratnam” BawwiH । sam--saMkzepe “samAsena niboData” purA॰ samasyA । saMkzipyanyasane yaTA pItam ambaramiti samudAyasya pItAmbara iti saMkzepeRa prayogaH samAsaH । “sarvvo'pyekadeSo'hnA saha samasyate” vArtti॰ । “samasyamAnapadArTAtiriktapadArTaboDakatvaM bahuvrIhitvamiti sAramaYjarI । “sasAsaH zaqibaDobDEH” hariH sAkalye ca samastam “jYAnamasti samastasya devImA॰ “vyastasamasta mahAvyAhfti home vini॰” Bavade॰ saMyojane ca samasya sampAdayata guRErimAm” kirA॰ ।

a: असभ्य — a. Unfit for an assembly, vulgar, low, obscene, indecent (words &c.).

m: अ-सखि m. an untrustworthy friend Comm. on Uṇ.
a: असखिः — An enemy, adversary.

m: अ-संभावना f. not regarding possible, Kād.
impossibility of comprehending, L.
want of respect, Bālar.
a: असंभावना — 1 Difficulty or impossibility of comprehending. --2 Improbability.

m: अ-संभावनीय mfn. inconceivable, incomprehensible, impossible, Mṛcch.
a: असंभावनीय, असंभाव्य — a. 1 Impossible. --2 Inconceivable, incomprehensible. --व्यं = असंभव्यं q. v.

m: अ-संभावित mfn. id., Kād.
unworthy of (gen.), ib.
असंभावितोपमा f. a simile that implies an impossibility, Kāvyād.
अ-संभाव्य mfn. = ˚भावनीय, q.v., MBh. xiii, 272, &c.
अ-संभाव्यम् ind. = अ-संभव्यम्, q.v., AitBr.
अ-संभाषा f. absence of conversation with (instr.), PārGṛ.
अ-संभाष्य mfn. one with whom one ought not to converse, MBh.; BhP.
unfit (as a place) for conversation, Mn. viii, 55.
अ-संभूति f. ‘nonexistence’, destruction, VS. xl, 9; ŚBr. xiv.
a: असंभूतिः — f. 1 Non-existence. --2 Not being born again. --3 Undeveloped cause (प्रकृति).

m: अ-संभव m. ‘nonexistence’, destruction, VS. xl, 10
non-happening, cessation, interruption, Mn. xi, 27
absence of, want, Mn.; MBh. &c.
impropriety, inconsistence, impossibility, KātyŚr.; Mn. &c.
non-coition, impotence, ĀpGṛ.
अ-संभव mfn. ‘non-happening’, inconsistent, impossible.
a: असंभव — a. Improbable, unlikely; inconsistent; असंभवं हेममृगस्य जन्म H. 1. 28. --वः 1 Non-existence; रामेणापि कथं न हेमहरिणस्यासंभवो लक्षितः Pt. 2. 4; Śi. 16. 34. --2 Improbability, impossibility. --वा, --वं An extraordinary event.
असंभव्य, असंभाविन् — a. 1 Impossible; असंभव्यं न वक्तव्यं. --2 Incomprehensible. --व्यं ind. In an incomprehensible or extraordinary manner.

m: अ-संभव्यम् ind. so as to prevent any restoration, AV. v, 18, 12 and 19, 11.
अ-संभेद m. non-contact, the being separate, ŚBr.
अ-संभेद्य mfn. not to be brought into contact, Hariv. 4504.

a: असंभृत — a. 1 Not brought about by artificial means, not artificial, natural; असंभृतं मंडनमंगयष्टेः Ku. 1. 31. --2 Not properly nourished.

m: अ-संभिन्दत् mfn. not damaging, PBr.
not bringing into contact, not mingling, TBr.
अ-संभिन्न mfn. not broken or passed (as barriers or bounds), MBh.
not being in contact, separated, separate, ŚBr.
अ-संभोग m. non-enjoyment, Hit.
absence of sexual union, MBh. v, 1524.
अ-संभोज्य mfn. one with whom one ought not to eat, Mn. ix, 238; MBh. xii, 4046.
अ-संभ्रान्तम् ind. = अ-संभ्रमम्, q.v., Mṛcch.
अ-संभ्रम mfn. free from flurry, composed, cool, MBh. &c.
a: असंभ्रम — a. Free from agitation, composed, cool. --मः Calmness, steadiness; R. 4. 72.

m: अ-संभ्रमम् ind. coolly, ib.
अ-संछन्न mfn. not covered, ŚBr.
अ-संधान n. want of aim or object
disjunction.
अ-संधेय mfn. not to be made peace with, MBh. xii, 6268; Hit.
for which no amends can be made, not to be redressed, AitBr.
अ-संधेय—ता f. the state of one with whom no peace is to be made, Veṇīs.
अ-संधि m. want of union or connection.
a: असंधि — a. 1 Not joined together (as words). --2 Not bound or restrained, at liberty. --धिः Absence of Saṃdhi or euphony.

m: अ-संधित mfn. for अ-संदित, q.v. (NBD.)
अ-संघट्ट m. non-collision, Ragh. xiv, 86.

m: अ-संख्यात mfn. uncounted, innumerable, AV. xii, 3, 28; VS.; ŚBr.; Kauś.
a: असंख्यात — a. Countless, innumerable.

m: अ-संख्य mf(आ)n. innumerable, exceedingly numerous, Mn.; Suśr. &c.
a: असंख्य — a. Beyond calculation, numberless, countless, innumerable; Ms. 1. 80; 12. 15; ˚ता, --त्वं infinity.

m: अ-संख्यशस् ind. in countless numbers, BhP.
अ-संख्यक mfn. id., AgP.
अ-संख्येय mfn. innumerable, MBh.; BhP. &c.
अ-संख्येय m. a N. of Śiva, L.
अ-संख्येय (अम्), n. an innumerable multitude, AV. x, 8, 24
an exceedingly large number, Buddh.
a: असंख्येय — a. Innumerable. --यः 1 An epithet of Śiva. --2 An epithet of Viṣṇu; V. Sahas. --यं An exceedingly large number. --Comp. --गुण a. innumerable.

m: अ-संख्येय—गुण mfn. innumerably multiplied, unnumbered.
अ-संख्येय—ता f. innumerableness, Suśr.
अ-संशब्द्य mfn. not worth mentioning, MBh. iii, 10695.

m: अ-संश्लिष्ट mfn. not in close contact, PBr.

a: असंश्लिष्ट — a. Not joined or united. --ष्टः An epithet of Śiva.

a: असंबाध — a. 1 Not narrow, spacious, wide. --2 Not crowded with people, lonely, solitary. --3 Open, accessible; Ki. 3. 53. --4 Separated by an interval; द्विपैरसंबाधमयांबभूवे Śi. 3. 67. --5 Without pain. --धा N. of a metre consisting of 56 syllables. --धं Ved. Open space.

a: असम — a. 1 Uneven, odd (as a number); असमशीलाः खलु मृगाः Bv. 1. 2 mean, contemptible. --2 Unequal (in space, number or dignity); असमैः समीयमानः Pt. 1. 74. --3 Unequalled, matchless, unsurpassed; समवतारसमैरसमैस्तटैः Ki. 5. 7; वाद्यविशेषाणामसमः श्रोता K. 12; Ms. 10. 73. --4 Uneven, not level (as ground). --मः N. of Buddha. --Comp. --इषुः, --बाणः, --सायकः ‘having an odd number of arrows,’ epithets of Cupid who has five arrows. --नयन, --नेत्र, --लोचन a. ‘having an odd number of eyes’, epithets of Śiva, who has three eyes. --वृत्तं a metre in which the ganas are not the same in all lines.

Udb. --3 Absurd, nonsensical, foolish. --सं Non-conformity, disparity, difference. --ind. 1 Unbecomingly, improperly. --2 In a fluctuating or confused manner.

maTApyasamAyihetutvam” iti ca BAzA॰ vyAKyAtaYcEtat muktA॰ । “tatra samavAyikAraRe AsannaM pratyAsannaM kAraRaM dvitIyamasamavAyikAraRamityarTaH atra yadyapi turItantusaMyogAnAM pawAsamavAyikAraRatvaMsyAt, evaM vegAdInAmapi aBiGAtAdyasamavAyikAraRatvaM syAt, evaM jYAnAdInAmicCAdyasamabAyikAratvaM syAt taTApi pawAsamavAyikAraRalakzaRe turItantusaMyogaBinnatvaM deyaM, GawAdikaM prati kapAlasaMyogAdikaM, tatra kAryyeRa Gawena saha kAraRasya kapAlasaMyogasya ekasmin kapAle pratyAsattirasti, dvitIyaM yaTA GawarUpaM prati kAraRaM GawaH tena saha kapAlarUpasya ekasmin
